title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned the Railway Reservation Chart. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Reservation Chart
options.lineage: Indian Railways reservation charts, printed timetables, and PNR slips
options.thesis: The leaderboard as the printed chart students find themselves on: dense dot-matrix rows, position codes, and the 75% line as a reservation status.
options.viewport: A deep-blue chart-head strip, the viewer's own line printed as a ticket strip (23BQ1A05Y3 | 76.4% | POS 47), then ranked dot-matrix rows with the 75% cutoff dividing confirmed rows from the waiting-list block.
options.risk: Reads as officialdom or retro-terminal when the print rhythm is loose; the play must come from the status drama, never decoration.

raised.raise: Decode discipline: every chart code (WL 71.2, CNF, ATT) decodes to plain language in place — no code ships without its legend.
Ground division: the table divides by colour fields and space, never by ruled borders; hairlines stay rationed to the chart rail.
Step honesty: every state change lands in discrete two-frame steps, printed not faded — no easing curve anywhere.

options.label: The Attendance Register
options.lineage: cloth-bound class attendance registers and red-ink roll calls
options.thesis: The leaderboard as the register itself: roll-ordered rows, ink marks, and the red 75% rule everyone fears, run through a working table.
options.viewport: A green cloth head-band, one dense register-ordered table with rank and roll in the left rail, the red 75% rule drawn live across the list, and the viewer's row bracketed in the margin.
options.risk: The most literal and most familiar option — it tips into costume if ruled lines replace the table, and it is where most runs in this category would land.

options.label: The Concourse Board
options.thesis: Rows as live entities: ranks cascade character by character, and stale data rests under an amber lamp until it is re-flapped.
options.viewport: One fixed board of ranked rows in locked columns — RNK / ROLL / ATT% — with the viewer's row clacking into place under a delay lamp when data is stale.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: ranks are board rows and staleness is a delay lamp; loses narrowly on identification — a board you watch, not a chart you are on.
options.risk: Motion-led: the cascade can obscure scanning when overused, and spectacle can turn the ranking into theatre.

options.label: The Warm App
options.thesis: Soft cards on a warm ground with one saturated action colour — the frictionless app idiom everyone already knows.
options.viewport: A friendly ranked list in white cards on a warm ground, one bright action colour on the profile bar, and thumb-reachable everything.
options.case: Holds product clarity absolutely — every pattern is proven; loses identification: nothing here is NBKRIST's.
options.risk: Indistinguishable from every other polished app; safe to the point of anonymity.

options.label: The Timetable Rack
options.lineage: printed timetables read as a raked rack of tinted slides on goldenrod
options.thesis: One type size throughout, hierarchy carried by weight, case, and rule — a leaderboard set in strict timetable rhythm.
options.viewport: Ranked entries as columns of rules on a goldenrod bed, one reversed ivory plate carrying the viewer's own position, a tick rail marking extent at the edge.
options.case: Holds clarity with real information-design discipline; loses identification — a timetable is read for times, not for who you are.
options.risk: One-size typography is severe; without exacting rules and rhythm it degrades into plain dense text.

options.label: The Catalog Sleeve
options.lineage: factory-records sleeves with colour-code strips and pulse plots
options.thesis: Ranks as a white pulse plot on vast matte black, names encoded as colour blocks decoded on touch.
options.viewport: Vast unprinted black with a single white pulse line as the rank history and a small fac-number as the only headline.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a British design canon the students do not live in, and coded labels trade clarity for mystique.
options.kept: Kept the decode discipline: its colour-strip ledger forced every code to have a legend — now every chart code decodes in place.

options.label: The Guide Map
options.lineage: zoo and gardens guide maps of flat colour lobes
options.thesis: Areas as swelling flat-colour lobes divided by coastline, not by borders, with capsule chips riding the coast.
options.viewport: One swelling colour field as the ground, ranked entries pinned along its coast, the ground showing through the middle as water.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a Western park-guide idiom the audience barely knows, and soft lobes do not carry a ranked list.
options.kept: Kept the ground division: colour fields and space separate the table's zones without a single ruled border.

options.label: The Acetate Manual
options.lineage: boxed-software manuals with divider boards and punched acetate leaves
options.thesis: Every panel a clear leaf hinged over a full-strength section colour; selection is a punched hole, error a vermilion slip.
options.viewport: A divider-hue head board with content on punched clear leaves, a stepped tab rail down the fore edge, nothing easing or fading.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a print-craft canon with weak audience recognition, and acetate layering is ornament on a working screen.
options.kept: Kept the step honesty: changes land in discrete two-frame steps hinged like a leaf — no easing anywhere.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What this category ships, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: The arrangement a visitor expects — clean tabs, clear rows, one blue accent — at full craft.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
